claims.quote: This specie is well-distributed around the Mediterranean coastline, including the Adriatic Sea, and has been recorded from the countries of France, Italy, Slovenia, Croatia, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Montenegro, Albania, Greece, Turkey, Syria, Lebanon, Israel, Egypt, Libya, Tunisia and around the islands of Sardinia, Corsica, Sicily and Malta.
